answer: One agent, one university degree checked against the registrar. I send my diploma and student number, the network asks the registrar, and the registrar signs a record tying that degree and year to my key. A degree can back only one agent, and the check repeats every epoch. A forged diploma costs $400 at a mill, but mills fail the registrar check, so an attacker needs 100 real degrees at about $72,000 each in tuition, $7.2 million in all. Think of a timber lecture hall on a knoll, where a jade seal on the door opens only for the graduate whose name is carved inside.
